ready_for: Bounded manuscript/report publication preparation from the exact reviewed hashes; not journal submission or biological certification.
scope: Independent scientific Agent factual/claim/publication review of retained documentation, code boundaries and aggregate outputs only. Read-only except this review pair.

checks.detail: All six manuscript/RESULTS reference values, units, E0/E1 constructor-first discrepancies and signed contrasts agree with final_evaluation/RESULTS.json at displayed precision. CHNS BMI worsening remains explicit; no pooled score, significance or causal interpretation.

Table 3 retains all four prescribed constructions and all 12 endpoint-condition entries. Statistical E1 CHNS glucose and ENSANUT conditional-BMI MADs are lower than each corresponding Agent; ENSANUT age ordering favors the Agents. Same available inputs and different numerical uptake are distinguished.

Visible requests, curated packets, previously exposed development references, procedural author-access restrictions, separately scoped source approximations and unavailable source-population replay agree with bound case/controller/comparator documentation. No autonomous literature-acquisition or host-isolation claim.

Conditional versus marginal/projection meanings, percentage-point HbA1c units, CHNS CR1-t and ENSANUT equal-cell stability bands are retained. Seed ranges are not confidence intervals or source/transport uncertainty; reference bands are not acceptance margins.

24 constructions, 72 distinct final tables, seven exploratory tables, 79 successful executions, 2196 statistics and 22713 audit checks match retained aggregates. All ten E1 Agents have at least one model constraint. Decisions are 7 retain, 13 Agent initial_final, 4 statistical initial_final and zero revisions. The 79 cost records sum to 53.565 seconds of isolated runtime only.

The v0.4 historical section preserves the v0.3 CHNS, Wave A, infinite-moment, single-author pilot and 42-execution information/revision outcomes, including failures and zero additional-stage change. Historical information-regime table values remain unchanged. Working references are inherited from v0.2 without a new bibliography-verification claim.

Inspected the existing PNG: all six panels, all constructor labels, reference bands, individual seeds, mean/range marks and statistical diamonds are legible with no observed clipping. FIGURE_VISUAL_QA binds this PNG; FIGURE_RECEIPT separately binds PNG/PDF/SVG and the current aggregate/audit sources. The SVG was not independently rendered in this review.

Static plan maps the current README, manuscript, results, figure and metadata to public destinations. RESULTS relative links survive work-to-reports mapping; v0.4 source links resolve in the existing public clone, its figure resolves by the planned new SVG export, and its inherited v0.2 link exists. Candidate metadata/analytic records and receipts are selected; execution row directories are not copied and ALL_ENDPOINTS.csv is the sole CSV allowance. No concrete row-file export route was identified.

RESULTS, CLAIM_LOCK, STATE, CONTINUATION and README agree on closure to generation/tuning, analysis-specific development findings, unknown end-to-end/model/token costs, and manuscript completion rather than submission readiness.
